caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of an oval-shaped metal ring, colored in dark brown tones, with two straight legs extending downward from its bottom left and bottom right sides. There is a curved, S-shaped element inside the oval ring, also colored dark brown, connected to the edges of the ring. To the right side, there is a looped handle formed by the continuation of the frame, extending outward from the ring. The drawing appears to be rendered with detailed shading to represent the metallic texture and form of the object. The artist's signature, “L. Weinrich,” appears in red-brown ink below and to the right of the object.
title: Trivet
